response.passage: In the bustling markets of Connaught Place, Delhi, consumer awareness remains a vital shield against exploitation. On 15th March 2023, a local activist named Mr. Sharma organized a workshop to educate shoppers about their rights. He explained that unfair trade practices often occur because sellers prioritize profit margins over product quality. For instance, if a shopkeeper sells a defective electronic item, the consumer has the right to demand a full refund or a replacement. However, many shoppers are unaware that they must keep their original cash memo as proof of purchase. Mrs. Gupta, a regular visitor to the market, once struggled to return a faulty blender because she had discarded her receipt. Mr. Sharma emphasized that the Consumer Protection Act of 2019 provides the legal framework for these grievances. He noted that 45 complaints were resolved in the district last month alone. By understanding these rules, citizens can ensure they are not cheated by dishonest traders. It is essential to remember that rights are only effective when consumers take the initiative to document their transactions properly.
response.summary: This passage explains the importance of consumer awareness and documentation in the Indian market. It highlights how legal frameworks like the Consumer Protection Act help resolve disputes when shoppers keep their receipts.
